description: Model Context Protocol server for Sonos audio devices

tool_signatures.name: sonos-agent-instructions
tool_signatures.description: Instructions for AI agents on how to properly control Sonos devices using the MCP tools

tool_signatures.name: sonos_add_device
tool_signatures.description: Manually add a Sonos device by IP address. Use when SSDP discovery fails due to network restrictions or firewall rules. Device must be network-accessible on port 1400.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_add_to_queue
tool_signatures.description: Add a track URI to the playback queue. Supports music library URIs and streaming service URIs. Optional metadata in DIDL-Lite XML format.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_agent
tool_signatures.description: An AI-powered assistant that can take natural language instructions and autonomously control the Sonos system. Use this when you need to solve complex multi-step tasks or when you\

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_albums
tool_signatures.description: Browse albums in the music library. Supports pagination for large collections.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_artists
tool_signatures.description: Browse artists in the music library. Supports pagination for large collections.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_genres
tool_signatures.description: Browse music genres in the library. Supports pagination for large collections.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_item
tool_signatures.description: Browse a specific library item to get its children. For example, get albums for an artist or tracks for an album.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_music_service
tool_signatures.description: Browse content from a music service. WARNING: Most services (especially Sonos Radio, Spotify, Apple Music) require authentication and will return empty results or errors if not authenticated. Check authType from sonos_list_music_services first. Only

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_playlists
tool_signatures.description: Browse Sonos playlists. Supports pagination for large collections.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_browse_tracks
tool_signatures.description: Browse all tracks in the music library. Supports pagination for large collections.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_cancel_sleep_timer
tool_signatures.description: Cancel the active sleep timer.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_clear_queue
tool_signatures.description: Remove all tracks from the queue. Does not stop current playback.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_create_alarm
tool_signatures.description: Create a new alarm with specified time, days, music source, and settings. Returns the alarm ID.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_delete_alarm
tool_signatures.description: Delete an existing alarm permanently.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_discover
tool_signatures.description: Actively scan the network for Sonos devices using SSDP. Always call this when the sonos_list_devices tool returns empty or you are missing a device. Returns device UUID, IP address, room name, model, and firmware version. Use room name to communicate with the user.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_eq
tool_signatures.description: Get current EQ settings including bass, treble, and loudness.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_favorite_radio_stations
tool_signatures.description: Get favorite radio stations from Sonos favorites. Returns a list of saved radio stations with their metadata and streaming URIs.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_music_service_item_uri
tool_signatures.description: Get the playable streaming URI for a specific music service item. This is useful for debugging or inspecting the actual stream URL.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_playback_state
tool_signatures.description: Get current playback settings including shuffle, repeat, crossfade, transport state, and speed.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_position_info
tool_signatures.description: Get current track information, position, and duration. Includes track metadata like title, artist, album.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_queue
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve the current playback queue with track information. Supports pagination for large queues.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_sleep_timer
tool_signatures.description: Get remaining sleep timer duration. Returns empty if no timer is active.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_transport_info
tool_signatures.description: Get current transport state (playing, paused, stopped) and playback speed.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_volume
tool_signatures.description: Get current volume level from a Sonos device.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_get_zone_groups
tool_signatures.description: Get zone group topology showing which devices are grouped together and their coordinator.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_join_group
tool_signatures.description: Join a device to another device\

tool_signatures.name: sonos_list_alarms
tool_signatures.description: List all configured alarms including their schedule, enabled status, and room assignments.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_list_devices
tool_signatures.description: List devices currently in the registry. Note: Call sonos_discover first to populate the registry if a device is not found in the current registry. Returns UUID, IP address, room name, model, and software version of registered devices. Use room name to communicate with the user.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_list_music_services
tool_signatures.description: List all available music services (Sonos Radio, TuneIn, Spotify, etc.) registered with the Sonos system. Returns service details including name, ID, and authentication type. IMPORTANT: Most services require authentication (authType: DeviceLink or AppLink) and will not work unless the user has linked their account through the Sonos app. Only

tool_signatures.name: sonos_list_subscriptions
tool_signatures.description: List all active event subscriptions for a device including subscription IDs and services.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_next
tool_signatures.description: Skip to next track in the queue.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_party_mode
tool_signatures.description: Join all discovered devices to the specified device to create a whole-house audio experience.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_pause
tool_signatures.description: Pause playback on a Sonos device. Maintains current position in track and queue for quick resume. If device is in a group, affects entire group.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_play
tool_signatures.description: Start or resume playback on a Sonos device. Continues from current queue position and respects volume settings. If device is in a group, affects entire group.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_play_from_queue
tool_signatures.description: Start playing from the queue at a specific position.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_play_music_service_item
tool_signatures.description: Play a specific item from a music service such as a radio station, track, album, or playlist. Use the item ID from browse or search results.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_previous
tool_signatures.description: Skip to previous track or restart current track if played more than a few seconds.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_remove_from_queue
tool_signatures.description: Remove a track from the queue at the specified position.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_restore_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Restore a previously saved snapshot to return device to its captured state. Optionally fade in volume.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_save_queue
tool_signatures.description: Save the current queue as a Sonos playlist with the specified title.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_search_library
tool_signatures.description: Search the music library by artist, album, track, or genre. Returns matching items.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_search_music_service
tool_signatures.description: Search for content within a music service. WARNING: Requires authentication for most services. Will return errors if the service requires DeviceLink or AppLink authentication and the user has not linked their account in the Sonos app. Prefer sonos_get_favorite_radio_stations for radio content.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_bass
tool_signatures.description: Set bass EQ level. Range: -10 (reduced bass) to +10 (enhanced bass).

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_crossfade
tool_signatures.description: Enable or disable crossfade between tracks. Crossfade creates smooth transitions between songs.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_dialog_mode
tool_signatures.description: Set dialog enhancement for home theater devices. Enhances speech clarity in movies and TV shows.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_loudness
tool_signatures.description: Enable or disable loudness compensation. Loudness boosts bass and treble at low volumes for better sound quality.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_mute
tool_signatures.description: Mute or unmute a Sonos device. Mute preserves volume level for quick unmute.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_night_mode
tool_signatures.description: Set night mode for home theater devices. Reduces loud sounds and enhances quiet sounds for late-night viewing.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_repeat
tool_signatures.description: Set repeat mode for queue playback. Options: off (no repeat), all (repeat entire queue), one (repeat current track).

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_shuffle
tool_signatures.description: Enable or disable shuffle mode for queue playback.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_sleep_timer
tool_signatures.description: Set a sleep timer to automatically stop playback after the specified duration. Format: HH:MM:SS (e.g.,

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_treble
tool_signatures.description: Set treble EQ level. Range: -10 (reduced treble) to +10 (enhanced treble).

tool_signatures.name: sonos_set_volume
tool_signatures.description: Set volume level on a Sonos device. Range: 0 (silent) to 100 (maximum). Affects entire group if device is grouped.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Take a snapshot of current device state including playback, volume, and EQ settings. Returns snapshot data for later restoration.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_stop
tool_signatures.description: Stop playback on a Sonos device. Clears playback state, unlike pause which maintains position.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_subscribe_events
tool_signatures.description: Subscribe to real-time events from a Sonos device service to receive automatic notifications of state changes.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_unjoin
tool_signatures.description: Remove a device from its current group, making it a standalone player.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_unsubscribe_all
tool_signatures.description: Unsubscribe from all active event subscriptions for a specific device.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_unsubscribe_events
tool_signatures.description: Unsubscribe from a specific event subscription to stop receiving notifications.

tool_signatures.name: sonos_update_alarm
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing alarm. Only specified fields will be changed.
